title: Disney’s Beloved Animated Reboot is Now Free to Watch
content: Disney Afternoon was an establishment of the entertainment studio for years, introducing animation enthusiasts to some of the biggest original properties of the ’90s. Shows like Gargoyles, Darkwing Duck, Bonkers, Chip ‘n Dale: Rescue Rangers , and Goof Troop were just a few examples of shows that remain fan-favorites…
author: ComicBook

title: Galaxy Express 999 TV Anime, Lupin III Film's Lyricist Jun Hashimoto Dies
content: Hashimoto wrote the lyrics for the Galaxy Express 999 television anime's titular opening theme song and ending theme song "Aoi Chikyū" (Blue Earth), as well as the "Honoo no Takaramono" (Blazing Treasure) theme song for Hayao Miyazaki 's debut feature film Lupin III: The Castle of Cagliostro .
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Film Concert Reveals New Visual Ahead of August Performances
content: The upcoming Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Film Concert 2026 has revealed a new key visual ahead of its performances this August in Yokohama, Japan. The concert will be conducted by Hirofumi Kurita. Evan Call , who composed music for Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End since its first season , is set to appear as a guest.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'You, Fireworks, and Our Promise' Anime Film Casts 3 AVAM Idols
content: The staff for the anime film of Kaori Mado 's You, Fireworks, and Our Promise ( Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to or Kimi-Hana for short) novel series announced three more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand Anime Casts Miharu Hanai, Suzuna Kinoshita
content: The staff for the television anime of Ezogingitune and illustrator DeeCHA 's I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand ( Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita. ) light novel series announced two more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Reveals Japan National Soccer Team Collaboration Ahead of 2026 World Cup
content: My Hero Academia anime has announced a new collaboration with Japan’s national football team, SAMURAI BLUE, featuring new artwork of several fan-favorite heroes wearing the team’s official 2026 uniforms.
author: Anime Corner

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 9 Preview Teases Will and Elfaria's Backstory
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 9 (Episode 21 overall). The preview features Will and Elfaria as children, showing that we will learn more about that shared past.
author: Anime Corner

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Goes into the Animal Kingdom in Episode 9 Preview
content: MARRIAGETOXIN anime revealed a recap trailer alongside the Episode 9 preview images and synopsis, ahead of the episode’s June 2 release. Studio BONES Film is handling the animation production, which premiered on April 3 . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Subaru Doubts Everyone in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 9 Preview, Features Long Awaited "Aura Monster" Scene
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 9 (Episode 75 overall) preview ahead of its June 3, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season , as well as the sixth one .
author: Anime Corner

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Tomokazu Sugita as Cyborg 004
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Tuesday that Tomokazu Sugita will voice Cyborg 004/Albert Heinrich in the series.
author: ANN
